Task Guide:


Task: Bulk Modulus of Aluminum
Description: Calculate the bulk modulus of aluminum by computing the full elastic stiffness tensor using finite deformation and stress analysis. Use the Embedded Atom Method (EAM) potential for aluminum. Apply small finite deformations in each of the six independent strain modes (ε₁ to ε₆ in Voigt notation: ε₁ = ε<sub>xx</sub>, ε₂ = ε<sub>yy</sub>, ε₃ = ε<sub>zz</sub>, ε₄ = 2ε<sub>yz</sub>, ε₅ = 2ε<sub>xz</sub>, ε₆ = 2ε<sub>xy</sub>), one at a time. From the resulting stress-strain data, compute the full 6×6 elastic stiffness matrix (C<sub>ij</sub>). Report the bulk modulus in GPa via Voigt averaging.

Required submission format:
numerical value without units (eg. 56.00)


Available input data:
All the potentials, can be found at /potentials/. Note that in case of reaxff potentials, pair style 'reax/c' has been renamed to 'reaxff' and always use NULL for the control file (cfile), for example, this syntax is correct : pair_style reaxff NULL.

- units: metal
- pbc: true
- minimiser: conjugate gradient
- energy_tolerance: 1e-10
- force_tolerance: 1e-10
- maximum_iterations: 100000.0
- maximum_evaluations: 100000.0
- materials_project_id: mp-134
- atom_style: atomic
- deformation_step_size: 1e-06
- total_deformation: -1 * (deformation_step_size * lattice parameter)

IMPORTANT: You have access to filesystem tools. All files will be saved in your isolated workspace.
 Save all the files in /results/2_AUGUST_2025/claude_35/tool_calling/bulk_modulus/brief/tasks/aluminum_bulk_modulus_trial_0 when using tools use this path.

When you think that the task is completed, you can submit the answer.
For that, answer with: "Final Answer: <your answer>". It is very important to follow this format.

function.name: write_file
function.arguments:
{"path": "/results/2_AUGUST_2025/claude_35/tool_calling/bulk_modulus/brief/tasks/aluminum_bulk_modulus_trial_0/in.elastic", "content": "# LAMMPS input script for elastic constants calculation

# Initialization
units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p

# Read structure
read_data Al.data

# EAM potential for Al
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/Al_nist.eam.alloy Al

# Energy minimization
minimize 1.0e-10 1.0e-10 100000 100000

# Set up elastic calculation
change_box all triclinic

# Define variables
variable up equal 1.0e-6
variable atomvolume equal vol/atoms

# Initial elastic matrix
variable C11 equal 0.0
variable C12 equal 0.0
variable C13 equal 0.0
variable C14 equal 0.0
variable C15 equal 0.0
variable C16 equal 0.0
variable C22 equal 0.0
variable C23 equal 0.0
variable C24 equal 0.0
variable C25 equal 0.0
variable C26 equal 0.0
variable C33 equal 0.0
variable C34 equal 0.0
variable C35 equal 0.0
variable C36 equal 0.0
variable C44 equal 0.0
variable C45 equal 0.0
variable C46 equal 0.0
variable C55 equal 0.0
variable C56 equal 0.0
variable C66 equal 0.0

# Calculate elastic constants
fix 3 all box/relax aniso 0.0

# Strain in x
variable tmp equal "lx"
variable L0 equal ${tmp}
variable tmp equal "ly"
variable L1 equal ${tmp}
variable tmp equal "lz"
variable L2 equal ${tmp}
variable strain equal ${up}
fix 5 all deform 1 x scale ${strain} y scale 1.0 z scale 1.0 remap x
minimize 1.0e-10 1.0e-10 100000 100000
variable C11 equal "-pxx/(${strain})*${atomvolume}"
unfix 5

# Strain in y
fix 5 all deform 1 x scale 1.0 y scale ${strain} z scale 1.0 remap x
minimize 1.0e-10 1.0e-10 100000 100000
variable C22 equal "-pyy/(${strain})*${atomvolume}"
unfix 5

# Strain in z
fix 5 all deform 1 x scale 1.0 y scale 1.0 z scale ${strain} remap x
minimize 1.0e-10 1.0e-10 100000 100000
variable C33 equal "-pzz/(${strain})*${atomvolume}"
unfix 5

# xy shear
fix 5 all deform 1 xy scale ${strain} remap x
minimize 1.0e-10 1.0e-10 100000 100000
variable C66 equal "-pxy/(${strain})*${atomvolume}"
unfix 5

# xz shear
fix 5 all deform 1 xz scale ${strain} remap x
minimize 1.0e-10 1.0e-10 100000 100000
variable C55 equal "-pxz/(${strain})*${atomvolume}"
unfix 5

# yz shear
fix 5 all deform 1 yz scale ${strain} remap x
minimize 1.0e-10 1.0e-10 100000 100000
variable C44 equal "-pyz/(${strain})*${atomvolume}"
unfix 5

# Calculate Bulk modulus (Voigt average)
variable B equal "(${C11}+${C22}+${C33}+2*(${C12}+${C13}+${C23}))/9"

# Output results
print "C11 = ${C11} GPa"
print "C22 = ${C22} GPa"
print "C33 = ${C33} GPa"
print "C44 = ${C44} GPa"
print "C55 = ${C55} GPa"
print "C66 = ${C66} GPa"
print "Bulk modulus = ${B} GPa""}
